text:
**Real bug caught while wiring desktop:** app.rs (sync_feed_author_refs/content/thread_reply_target) and timeline_panel.rs were STILL building "nmp.feed.home"/"nmp.feed.author.<pubkey>"/"nmp.feed.thread.<event_id>" literal keys against Snapshot::projection — stale since the chirp.timeline.* rename. Snapshot::projection takes any &str so it type-checked fine, just silently found nothing. Desktop's home/author/thread tabs have been rendering empty since that rename landed, and existing tests never caught it (they only exercise JSON-shape decoding, not the real key construction at the actual call site). Fixed all six sites + added a regression test.

**Proactive grep sweep (per your explicit ask):** grepped the whole tui+desktop+android-ffi tree for both the old "nmp.feed." literal and bare "chirp.timeline." literals. Old prefix: zero production hits (only comments). New prefix: found two more production sites hand-typing "chirp.timeline." as a prefix-match string instead of importing a constant — chirp-tui's typed_op_feeds/feeds_from and chirp-desktop's extract_op_feeds_from_typed. Added nmp_chirp_config::CHIRP_TIMELINE_NAMESPACE_PREFIX and routed both through it. nmp-chirp-android-ffi doesn't decode typed feed data on the Rust side at all, so nothing to route there. [...] 2. **`FeedParams` JSON shape is completely stale — FIXED.** `KernelBridge+FeedOperations.swift` hand-builds the JSON blob for `nmp_app_open_feed` and was still using the OLD field names: `render`/`acquisition`/`ranking: ChronologicalDesc`/`projection` — the exact same shape I migrated three times already this session for tui/desktop/android-ffi. Verified the current struct in `nmp-feed/src/params.rs` (`primary_kinds, shape, source, admission, order, window, key, item_projection`) and rewrote the whole file: `shape`/`source`/`order: NewestByFeedPosition`/`key` (still a bare string — `ProjectionKey` is `#[serde(try_from = "String", into = "String")]`) plus the new required `item_projection: "FeedRows"`. The `source` payload shapes for `ActiveUserFollows`/`Authors`/`Referrer` were already correct (unchanged). Also renamed `nmp.feed.home`/`.author.`/`.thread.` → `chirp.timeline.*` throughout this file plus `KernelModel+Lifecycle.swift`, `KernelUpdateFrameDecoder.swift`, `KernelModel+Apply.swift`. This one I'm confident in (verified field-by-field against source), but I have NOT build-tested it (see below). [...] **Proactive grep sweep (per your explicit ask):** grepped the whole tui+desktop+android-ffi tree for both the old "nmp.feed." literal and bare "chirp.timeline." literals. Old prefix: zero production hits (only comments). New prefix: found two more production sites hand-typing "chirp.timeline." as a prefix-match string instead of importing a constant — chirp-tui's typed_op_feeds/feeds_from and chirp-desktop's extract_op_feeds_from_typed. Added nmp_chirp_config::CHIRP_TIMELINE_NAMESPACE_PREFIX and routed both through it. nmp-chirp-android-ffi doesn't decode typed feed data on the Rust side at all, so nothing to route there.
